allowed_work: prepare a design-only Seed for later review
goal: Design Phase 3 system prompt evolution scope, acceptance criteria, and benchmark gate reactivation before any execution or active apply.
out_of_scope: running GEPA or DSPy optimization for system prompt sections
editing active Hermes Agent system prompt source
applying evolved prompt variants to active runtime configuration
changing canonical identity or SOUL artifacts

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Phase 3 design starts only after the Phase 2E human review checkpoint records Phase 2 closeout as complete.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Read reports/phase2e_human_review_checkpoint.json and verify phase2e_closeout_complete is true.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: This artifact defines a design boundary only; it does not execute optimization, mutate active prompts, or apply source/runtime changes.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Assert plan_only is true, execution_started is false, and active_system_prompt_apply_approved is false.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Only the five intended system prompt sections are in scope for later section-as-DSPy-parameter design.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Compare evolvable_sections to DEFAULT_AGENT_IDENTITY, MEMORY_GUIDANCE, SESSION_SEARCH_GUIDANCE, SKILLS_GUIDANCE, and PLATFORM_HINTS.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Private memory, generated skill indexes, project context files, identity/SOUL artifacts, credentials, and runtime configuration remain non-evolvable.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify non_evolvable_sections includes durable_user_or_private_memory, auto_generated_skills_index, project_context_files, and canonical_identity_or_soul_artifacts.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: The future evaluator must cover tool-use discipline, memory/session-search behavior, skill loading, platform formatting, identity/safety, and prompt-cache compatibility.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Check the Seed evaluation_plan lists these evaluator dimensions before any Phase 3 execution.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: TBLite/YC-Bench remain non-blocking for this design-only plan but become blocking before Phase 3 execution or prompt acceptance/apply.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Verify benchmark_gate_reactivation.required_before includes phase3_execution, system_prompt_evolution_acceptance, active_system_prompt_apply, and default_gate_promotion.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Any active system prompt/source apply must be separated into a later human-approved PR or patch.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Confirm active_system_prompt_apply_approved remains false and apply_ready remains false.

acceptance_criteria.criterion: Future variants must preserve prompt-cache boundaries and identity/safety constraints; personality or safety drift is a reject condition.
acceptance_criteria.verification: Require explicit cache-boundary and identity-safety checks in the future execution Seed before optimization starts.
